A few good questions.

Is $4.99 a monthly subscription?

Yes. The subscription is US$4.99 per month and includes 10 conversions each month.

Can I preview before subscribing?

Yes. Preview conversions include a visible watermark. Use a test result to review the tracing before choosing a paid option.

Which payment methods are available?

Subscribe by card through Stripe after signing in. Choose your payment method above to start checkout. Your account keeps your billing details and remaining conversions; uploaded images are not stored.

Will the SVG open in my design software?

SVG is supported by many vector editors. Open our sample in your own software to check compatibility before purchasing.

What happens if I need more conversions?

Your allowance renews after each successful monthly payment. Manage or cancel your subscription from your account.
